purpose: Illustrative lifestyle photographs for Lab Testing steps 3, 4, 5; no actual patients or product packaging.

Natural hands, realistic skin, soft daylight, ivory and muted navy palette, understated medical professionalism. Mid shot with her face and hands and materials legible.
